### WBWrite is now WBWriter

The app has a new name to match its home at **[wbwriter.app](https://wbwriter.app/)**. Everything else works as before.

- **New name everywhere:** the app, its icon and wordmark, the window titles and the default NDI® source name (`MACHINE (WBWriter)`).
- **Your settings carry over.** On first launch, WBWriter imports the settings you saved in WBWrite. If your NDI source was still called "WBWrite", it's renamed to "WBWriter". Update the source in your receivers if needed.
- **Allow Local Network access again.** macOS treats the renamed app as new, so it asks once more. Click **Allow**, or NDI won't work.

### Download

**macOS 13+** (Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized): download **`WBWriter-1.1.0.dmg`**, open it and drag WBWriter into Applications. You can then delete the old **WBWrite** app.

Linux and Windows are coming soon.
